per_round:
The session primarily optimized the test suite, not yet the planned `ledgerly/api/routes.py` split into per-resource routers. Replaced repeated organization setup with an `organization_factory` fixture, added batched customer creation, introduced a frozen clock for subscription renewal tests, and wired report and payment-method factory fixtures. Updated invoice fixtures/factories to share persisted organizations, removing duplicate inserts. The full suite now passes in 14.92 seconds: 318 passed, 4 skipped, with runtime reduced by about 25.55 seconds; payment tests pass in 1.96 seconds and invoice tests in 2.77 seconds.

Current work is an intermittent invoice-sync concurrency failure: `/v1/invoices/INV-1042/sync` sometimes returns 409 instead of 202. Repeated execution reproduced the race. `InvoiceSyncService.submit` opens a fresh database session and forwards idempotency keys, while related middleware exists, but completed responses are not persisted. Further investigation/fix should target atomic idempotency handling and concurrent submissions. Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 is ruled out because it breaks Stripe.

Optimized the test suite with shared factories, batched setup, frozen time, and fewer duplicate inserts; the full suite previously passed (318 passed, 4 skipped). Fixed the invoice-sync idempotency race by atomically claiming completed responses only for the matching invoice. Added a concurrent regression test; integration, unit, full-suite, stress, Ruff, and formatting checks passed. The fix was committed as `fix-billing-idempotency-race` (3 files, 19 insertions, 4 deletions). Do not modify `ledgerly/customer_export/` without a proposed diff in `#privacy-review` and approval from `@mina`.

Separately, the requested retention procedure has only completed step 1: 1,842,032 events predate the cutoff. Continue steps 2–8 sequentially.

Current coding work has started invoice API pagination: added `InvoicePage`, and updated `InvoiceService.list_invoices` with `limit=20`/`offset=0`. Existing API tests now have one failure because the route still returns a bare list rather than `{items, total, limit, offset}`. Update the route/schema contract and tests next.

Completed invoice API pagination: list endpoints now validate `limit` (1–100) and `offset`, return `{items,total,limit,offset}`, and include dedicated pagination/validation tests. Existing invoice API/service tests pass (18 total), and Ruff plus whitespace checks are clean. Worktree contains pagination changes in the invoice API, service, schema, and new tests.

Paused this for higher-priority dunning scheduler work: reminders are being sent to already-paid customers; investigate and fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`.

Separately profiled slow invoice summaries: tenant 73 takes ~38–39 seconds, dominated by repeated per-currency invoice queries (1,024 rows, 2,431 SQL statements). A temporary optimization was started to aggregate invoices once per account outside the currency loop, but it has not yet been tested or finalized. Router splitting remains paused.
